theme_identity.name: FIFA 19 Career Mode & FUT Web Hybrid Theme
theme_identity.description: Inspired directly by FIFA 19 Career Mode 'Office' grid panels and FUT Web Companion aesthetics. Features a deep navy/royal blue gradient canvas, sharp uppercase tile header bars, neon cyan and magenta light streak accents, condensed high-impact typography, and dense stats presentation.

rules.headers: Use uppercase font-black tracking-wider condensed style for all panel headers, tab items, and card titles.
rules.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white
rules.section_header: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wide text-white flex items-center gap-2
rules.tile_header: bg-[#182459] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#263878]

dashboard_office_grid.description: FIFA 19 Career Mode 'Office' grid with sharp rectangular tiles, uppercase header banners, and high-density stats.

layout_and_grid.tile_style: bg-[#0F1744] border border-[#22336E] shadow-xl overflow-hidden rounded-none hover:border-[#334A9C] transition-colors

navbar.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#080D2D]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#1E2E6B] px-4 py-3
navbar.tabs: uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm px-3 py-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer

cards.office_panel: rounded-none border border-[#22336E] bg-[#0E1540] flex flex-col
cards.panel_header_bar: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#182459] to-[#131C47] border-b border-[#253775] px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-white
cards.fut_card: bg-gradient-to-b from-[#221C0E] via-[#3B3016] to-[#120F08] border-2 border-[#D4AF37] text-white p-3 font-mono shadow-2xl relative

squad_builder.pitch_bg: relative bg-gradient-to-b from-[#092215] via-[#0D301E] to-[#081B10] border-2 border-[#1B5233] p-6 min-h-[580px] overflow-hidden rounded-sm
squad_builder.pitch_lines: absolute inset-0 border border-white/20 pointer-events-none rounded-sm
squad_builder.budget_bar: bg-[#090E2E] border border-[#22336E] p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4

compare_social_card.bg: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#060920] via-[#0E1642] to-[#080B26] p-8 border-4 border-[#00F2FE]/40 relative overflow-hidden
compare_social_card.watermark: text-8xl font-black text-white/5 absolute -right-6 -bottom-6 pointer-events-none select-none

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (tabs, filters, search inputs, profile buttons, squad builder slots, export buttons) MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the FIFA 19 Career Mode & FUT Web palette across App.js, Dashboard.jsx, Navbar.jsx, and all page components.
Maintain the sharp rectangular panel design with uppercase header bars for the Dashboard 'Office' layout.
Ensure all Recharts charts utilize cyan (#00F2FE), pink (#FF0055), green (#00E070), and gold (#FFB800) series colors on deep blue canvas backgrounds.
Include mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive UI controls.
Implement squad builder pitch view and shareable compare image card with FUT card styling.
Keep navigation clear and fully responsive with desktop tab list and mobile drawer.
